object_description: compact terrain-adapted building with detached perforated screen
design_condition: The compact building is intelligently integrated with the terrain and well inserted into its context, although its architectural expression is not fully convincing in relation to the urban context and required building type.

positive.statement: The project is a compact, well-proportioned building with an interesting typology that is optimally inserted into the context.
The detached perforated sunshade facade is captivating and offers interesting possibilities for managing light.
The section is intelligently developed and integrated with the shape of the terrain.
The ground-floor plan and portico are interesting.

negative.statement: The architectural expression is interesting but not entirely convincing in relation to the urban context and the required building type.
The requested clear floor height of 3.00 metres is not completely resolved.
The plans are excessively closed in on themselves, schematic, and less flexible than those of the other projects.
The upper floors are excessively conventional compared with the project's general formal expression.
